sloka: स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्।तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनिस्वनम् ।। ६.९७.२७ ।।
transliteration: sa samutthāya patitaḥ kapistasya vyasarjayat।talaprahāramaśaneḥ samānaṁ bhīmanisvanam ।। 6.97.27 ।।

translations.english: Dropped down by him (Virupaksha), Sugriva, got up, and gave the Rakshasa a slap with his palm which was equal to thunderbolt that produced a terrific sound like crash.
translations.hindi: रावणपुत्र मेघनाद भो, शत्र॒घाती शत्रु द्वारा अत्यन्त घायल हो लक्ष्मण जी पर अविरल बाणवृष्टि करने लगा
